sp_thwip_1.desc: Web shot, one hand (reference level): finger-snap crack, pump-spray pfft, descending air-whistle zip.

sp_thwip_2.desc: Web shot variant: whip-tip crack, air-duster hiss, brighter two-tone zip (+1.3 st).

sp_thwip_3.desc: Web shot variant: twig-snap crack, pneumatic-nailer air, darker glide, more body (-1.3 st).

sp_thwip_4.desc: Web shot variant: air-rifle crack, deodorant-spray hiss, highest and fastest zip glide.

sp_thwip_double.desc: Both hands at once: two different thwips 16 ms apart, spread L/R, plus a low pressure thump.

sp_thwip_swing.desc: Swing-line shot: a thwip followed by the line paying out ("thwip-zzzp"), 0.55 s.

sp_web_splat_1.desc: Web glob splatting on a wall: wet slap + sticky fibre crackle.

sp_web_splat_2.desc: Web splat variant: slime slap, pitched up, drier.

sp_web_splat_3.desc: Web splat variant: heavier squish, pitched down.

sp_web_hit_body.desc: Web glob hitting an enemy: body thud + wet slap.

sp_web_attach_1.desc: Swing line anchoring on a building: taut tchk + tiny string twang.

sp_web_release.desc: Letting go of a line: twang + air fizz.

sp_web_snap.desc: A web line breaking: sharp snap + whip recoil.

sp_zip_whoosh.desc: Web-zip: rising whoosh pulled along the line, ending in a small thump (0.85 s).

sp_web_pull.desc: Yanking an enemy with a web: taut snap + short whoosh.

sp_web_creak_1.desc: Line creak under load (bottom of a swing arc).

sp_web_creak_2.desc: Line creak variant: tight metal-wire gate creak, pitched up.

sp_swing_whoosh_1.desc: Air rushing past through the bottom of a swing arc (1.3 s swell).

sp_wind_loop.desc: High-speed wind loop for swinging/falling (seamless, 4 s).

sp_nano_flow.desc: Nanotech flowing over the body: fine metallic granular shimmer (2.8 s).

sp_nano_seal.desc: Suit complete: tight metallic click-chirp lock.

sp_nano_mask_open.desc: Mask receding into the collar: granular slide down.

sp_nano_mask_close.desc: Mask flowing up over the head, ends in a soft seal click.

sp_lens_focus.desc: Eye lenses adjusting: tiny iris click-whirr.

sp_leg_deploy.desc: Four mechanical legs extending: servo whirr + telescoping ratchet + lock (0.85 s).

sp_leg_stow.desc: Legs retracting: falling servo + ratchet + latch.

sp_leg_step_1.desc: A metal leg tip planting on concrete: sharp clack.

sp_leg_step_2.desc: A metal leg tip planting on concrete: sharp clack.

sp_leg_step_3.desc: A metal leg tip planting on concrete: sharp clack.

sp_leg_servo_1.desc: Short servo move of a leg joint.

sp_leg_servo_2.desc: Short servo move of a leg joint.

sp_leg_servo_3.desc: Short servo move of a leg joint.

sp_leg_strike.desc: A leg stabbing forward: blade whoosh + metallic impact.

sp_step_1.desc: Spider-Man footstep in the suit: light rubbery sneaker on concrete.

sp_step_2.desc: Spider-Man footstep in the suit: light rubbery sneaker on concrete.

sp_step_3.desc: Spider-Man footstep in the suit: light rubbery sneaker on concrete.

sp_step_4.desc: Spider-Man footstep in the suit: light rubbery sneaker on concrete.

sp_land_light.desc: Light landing on the balls of the feet.

sp_land_hard.desc: Three-point superhero landing: heavy thump + gritty scuff + faint suit rattle.

sp_jump.desc: Jump push-off: sneaker scuff + suit whoosh.

sp_punch_1.desc: Punch: whoosh + impact on a body.

sp_punch_2.desc: Punch: whoosh + impact on a body.

sp_kick.desc: Kick: big whoosh + heavy body impact.

sp_wall_grip.desc: Hands/feet sticking to a wall: soft grippy tk.

sp_window_handle.desc: Lever window handle turned 90 degrees: click/latch.

sp_window_push.desc: Casement pushed open: hinge creak + frame knock.

sp_sill_step.desc: Foot on a stone window sill.
